title: Verify that an unsupported Hero Banner image format is rejected

steps.action: Attempt to upload hero-banner.gif as Hero Banner
steps.expected: Upload is rejected with a format-not-supported error; no file is saved

title: Verify that a Hero Banner image exactly at the 2MB boundary is accepted

steps.action: Upload a file sized exactly 2MB as Hero Banner
steps.expected: Upload succeeds, no size-error is shown

title: Verify that an unsupported GM Portrait Image format (SVG) is rejected

steps.action: Attempt to upload gm-portrait.svg as GM Portrait Image
steps.expected: Upload rejected with a format-not-supported error

title: Verify that a valid Signature Avatar image uploads successfully as an optional field

steps.action: Upload avatar.png (200KB) as Signature Avatar and click Save
steps.expected: Image uploads and displays in the signature block preview

title: Verify that an unsupported Signature Avatar format is rejected even though the field is optional

steps.action: Attempt to upload avatar.bmp as Signature Avatar
steps.expected: Upload rejected with a format-not-supported error

title: Verify that a valid hyperlink URL entered in the message content is saved and rendered as a working link

steps.action: Insert the hyperlink into Page Content and click Save
steps.expected: Link saves without error

steps.action: Preview the page and click the link
steps.expected: Link opens per the approved open-behavior configuration (new tab/same tab as configured)

title: Verify that republishing a page immediately after unpublishing restores it to the live site correctly

steps.action: Unpublish the currently live record
steps.expected: Page goes offline

steps.action: Immediately click Publish again on the same record
steps.expected: Success toast appears; page is live again with all original content intact

title: Verify that rapidly double-clicking Publish does not create a duplicate publish action or duplicate audit log entry

steps.action: Click Publish twice in rapid succession on the same record
steps.expected: The page is published exactly once; the audit log records a single Publish event, not two

title: Verify that the system handles two admin sessions editing the same GM's Message Draft record concurrently without silent data loss

steps.action: Session A opens the record and edits Page Title
steps.expected: Change made but not yet saved

steps.action: Session B opens the same record, edits Page Content, and saves
steps.expected: Session B's change is saved

steps.action: Session A saves its Page Title change
steps.expected: System either shows a conflict/stale-data warning or applies last-write-wins without silently discarding Session B's change

title: Verify that an expired admin session forces re-authentication during GM's Message editing

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor and open the GM's Message edit form.
steps.expected: Form loads with current field values.

steps.action: Allow the session to expire (or force-expire it), then attempt to Save.
steps.expected: User is prompted to re-authenticate; in-progress unsaved field changes are not silently committed without a valid session.

title: Verify that a role change mid-session is reflected on the next permission-checked action

steps.action: With the Editor's session already open on the GM's Message record, an Administrator revokes the Editor's publish permission in a separate session.
steps.expected: Permission change is saved.

steps.action: The original Editor attempts to click Publish.
steps.expected: Action is rejected with the standard Access Denied message; the page status is unchanged.

title: Verify that publishing the GM's Message page records an audit log entry

steps.action: As Site Content Editor, publish a change to the GM's Message page.
steps.expected: Publish succeeds.

steps.action: Open the audit log for this page record.
steps.expected: A new entry is present showing the acting Editor's identity, the action ("Published"), and a timestamp matching the publish time.

title: Verify that Salutation Heading (EN) sanitizes embedded HTML tags

steps.action: Enter Dear members in Salutation Heading (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Raw HTML tags are stripped/escaped on the rendered page; no unintended bold rendering or raw tag text appears.

title: Verify that GM Name (EN) sanitizes embedded HTML tags

steps.action: Enter Ahmed in GM Name (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Tags are stripped/escaped on render; no raw HTML or unintended bold formatting appears in the caption/signature.

title: Verify that GM Designation (EN) sanitizes script injection input

steps.action: Enter in GM Designation (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Input is sanitized/escaped; no script executes on the rendered page.

title: Verify that Signature Closing Text (EN) sanitizes script injection input

steps.action: Enter in Signature Closing Text (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Input is sanitized/escaped; no script executes on render.

title: Verify that a valid Signature Avatar (EN) image uploads, saves, and persists

steps.action: Upload a 200KB .jpg file as Signature Avatar (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Upload accepted.

steps.action: Reload and view the published page.
steps.expected: The uploaded avatar image displays in the signature block (replacing the default gold placeholder).

title: Verify that an unsupported Signature Avatar (EN) file format is rejected

steps.action: Attempt to upload a .bmp file as Signature Avatar (EN).
steps.expected: Format validation error displays; upload is rejected.

title: Verify that the page saves and publishes successfully with no Signature Avatar uploaded

steps.action: Leave Signature Avatar (EN) empty and fill in all other mandatory fields, then click Publish.
steps.expected: Publish succeeds with no validation error for the avatar field; default gold-circle placeholder displays on the live page.

title: Verify that a valid Signature Avatar (AR) uploads, saves, and persists per language

steps.action: Upload a 200KB .png file as Signature Avatar (AR) and click Save.
steps.expected: Upload accepted.

steps.action: View the page with AR locale selected.
steps.expected: The AR-specific avatar image displays.

title: Verify that a valid hyperlink URL is saved and persists in the message body

steps.action: Insert a hyperlink with target URL https://www.qcci.org inside Page Content and click Save.
steps.expected: Value accepted.

steps.action: Reload and view the published page.
steps.expected: Link is retained, correctly targeted, and clickable per its configured open behavior.

title: Verify that an invalid hyperlink URL is rejected on save

steps.action: Insert a hyperlink with target "not-a-url" inside Page Content and click Save.
steps.expected: "Please enter a valid URL." error displays; save is blocked.

title: Verify that an image exactly at the 2MB boundary is accepted

steps.action: Upload a .jpg file sized exactly 2,097,152 bytes as Hero Banner (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Upload is accepted; no size-validation error displays.

title: Verify that an interrupted Publish action does not leave the page in a partially-published state

steps.action: As Site Content Editor, click Publish and immediately simulate a network interruption before the success toast appears.
steps.expected: Request does not complete.

steps.action: Check the record's Status after reconnecting.
steps.expected: Status remains at its prior value (Draft or previous Published version); no partially-applied/corrupted content is visible to a Visitor.

steps.action: Retry Publish.
steps.expected: Publish completes successfully and the page reflects the full intended content.

title: Verify that the outcome is deterministic when two Site Content Editors save the same GM's Message record concurrently

steps.action: Editor A and Editor B both open the same GM's Message record in separate browser sessions.
steps.expected: Both see the same current values.

steps.action: Editor A changes Page Content (EN) and clicks Save.
steps.expected: Editor A's change is stored.

steps.action: Editor B (still on the stale pre-Editor-A view) changes GM Designation (EN) and clicks Save.
steps.expected: Record the actual system behavior: whether Editor B's save overwrites Editor A's content change (data-loss risk) or the system surfaces a conflict warning before allowing the save.
